cards.summary: This 2003 EX Dragon holofoil card tops the week's spikes with a current market price of $321.06 after rising sharply from around $84 in late April/early May. Near Mint copies have dried up, with only one listing available in the $700s and a recent Near Mint sale at $1,000. It was selling under $100 just two months prior, highlighting extreme scarcity in vintage prints.

The promotional printing of Salamence saw two Near Mint copies sell in June for $100-150 each. At time of writing, exactly two Near Mint copies are listed for an eye-popping $1,000 each. This represents a massive jump in a very small supply printing from an older set.

The 2007 Power Keepers printing has also disappeared from the market, with Near Mint copies last selling in June for $250. Today there is just a singular Near Mint copy listed at $380. This continues the trend of vintage Salamence variants spiking due to low supply.

This XY promotional printing of Blastoise-EX has spiked hard, reaching a new all-time high of well over $300 for a Near Mint copy. Five years ago it was readily available around $5, and it first moved significantly in 2021 to almost $50. The card continues its strong 2026 run with another big week.

The promotional printing of Armored Mewtwo climbed from $250 to just over $275 in the past week after steady gains in 2025 and flat performance earlier in 2026. This unique style of Mewtwo in armor shows potential for further movement. Only time will tell if it catches on bigger.
